annotationSourcesInfo.name: OncoKB
annotationSourcesInfo.description: OncoKB™ is a precision oncology knowledge base that contains biological and clinical information about genomic alterations in cancer.

annotationSourcesInfo.name: PDB
annotationSourcesInfo.description: A resource for the three-dimensional structural data of large biological molecules such as proteins and nucleic acids.

annotationSourcesInfo.name: xrefs
annotationSourcesInfo.description: Xref endpoint is a lookup of Ensembl Identifiers and retrieve their external references in other databases

annotationSourcesInfo.name: My Variant Info
annotationSourcesInfo.description: "MyVariant.info provides simple-to-use REST web services to query/retrieve variant annotation data, aggregated from many popular data resources."

annotationSourcesInfo.name: PFAM
annotationSourcesInfo.description: A database of protein families that includes their annotations and multiple sequence alignments generated using hidden Markov models.

annotationSourcesInfo.name: Cancer Hotspots
annotationSourcesInfo.description: A resource for statistically significant mutations in cancer

annotationSourcesInfo.name: PTM
annotationSourcesInfo.description: A resource for protein post-translational modifications (PTMs).

annotationSourcesInfo.name: SignalDB
annotationSourcesInfo.description: The SIGNAL resource integrates germline and somatic alterations identified by clinical sequencing of active cancer patients.

annotationSourcesInfo.name: Sift
annotationSourcesInfo.description: SIFT predicts whether an amino acid substitution is likely to affect protein function based on sequence homology and the physico-chemical similarity between the alternate amino acids.

annotationSourcesInfo.name: Polyphen-2
annotationSourcesInfo.description: "PolyPhen-2 predicts the effect of an amino acid substitution on the structure and function of a protein using sequence homology, Pfam annotations, 3D structures from PDB where available, and a number of other databases and tools (including DSSP, ncoils etc.)"

annotationSourcesInfo.name: ClinVar
annotationSourcesInfo.description: ClinVar aggregates information about genomic variation and its relationship to human health.

annotationSourcesInfo.name: VEP
annotationSourcesInfo.description: "VEP determines the effect of your variants(SNPs, insertions, deletions, CNVs or structural variants) on genes, transcripts, and protein sequence, as well as regulatory regions."

annotationSourcesInfo.name: HGNC
annotationSourcesInfo.description: The resource for approved human gene nomenclature. Genome Nexus uses HGNC gene symbols in annotation

annotationSourcesInfo.name: 3D Hotspots
annotationSourcesInfo.description: A resource for statistically significant mutations clustering in 3d protein structures in cancer

annotationSourcesInfo.name: reVUE
annotationSourcesInfo.description: A Repository for Variants with Unexpected Effects (VUE) in Cancer
